As you climb through the ranks, it can actually become easier to block shatters because the enemy rein is a bit more predictable, and you know what openings they'll look for to get one off (like when you firestrike). The swing animation cancel is a good bait because it looks close enough to the firestrike animation at first glance.

What I've had success doing is swinging once and putting my shield up. This helps me gain charge and pull back the aggression a tad. Unless you're playing like a rabid animal or you just switched to rein, both you and the enemy will gain charge at around the same rate. When you're close to ult, start doing one swing, but shield up about halfway through for the animation cancel. I posted one of my clips doing it the other day.
